thread:
ashley: Quick heads up  PR #644 added a troubleshooting section for throttling + context trims. A couple of SDK params in the samples are out of date. Can someone scrub?
jia: Point me to the lines and Ill update.
ashley: Top snippet still shows `max_concurrency` and `429_retry: true`. In SDK 0.9 we renamed to `concurrency_limit` and retries are handled by the runtime fallback, so remove the flag and note the behavior.
sam: Ill open a micro-PR to patch the snippet and add a tiny migration table (old -> new).
mike: Please add a short note about batching tradeoffs (cost vs p99) and an example command to repro noisy 429s in staging.
jia: Draft diff: ```diff
- client.config({max_concurrency: 12, 429_retry: true})
+ client.config({concurrency_limit: 12})
```
olivia: Can we also add a minimal example under examples/ that runs the snippet against a mock server so CI fails if we change the API again?
ashley: Good call. @doc-bot attach a docs-qa checklist to PR: samples-lint, example-ci, migration-note, links-check.
doc-bot: checklist attached to PR #644  items: samples-lint, example-ci, migration-note, links-check
sam: I'll own sample compile + CI wiring. jia, can you write the migration copy and a tiny "If you see more 429s after upgrading" list with 3 fixes?
jia: Yep  will add: tune `concurrency_limit`, enable prefix/KV cache, and implement exp backoff with jitter. Also add a quick staging repro: `hey -n 600 -c 40 https://staging.api.redwood/v1/generate` and note to run from same region.
mike: +1. Add a one-line compatibility table at the top for SDK <0.9 -> 0.9+.
ashley: Plan: land the docs PR by EOD Thursday. After merge, backport the migration note to the older troubleshooting page for 0.8-era users.
doc-bot: backport issue queued post-merge. :white_check_mark:
